answer: Anchor each identity to a verified contribution ledger, not a password. First, an agent links work that independent maintainers merged and signed. Second, peers verify those signatures before granting weight, so a fresh identity starts at zero however polished. Third, weight grows only as real merges accumulate, and a maintainer caught signing fake work loses their own standing. Forging 10,000 fakes means faking 10,000 signed histories, burning $900,000 and 120 days of coordination. Trust here is no velvet over a yarrow stalk; it is a glacier, slow, heavy, impossible to fake overnight.
